messages:
Maya R.: Heads up—Acme product team visiting tomorrow ~11am. Do they need pre-printed badges or can we do visitor day-passes at the desk? Also spotted 8 boxes stacked at the front desk. Any plan for package overflow?
Front-desk-bot: New package scan: 6 items for Maya R., 2 items for Kevin L. Items placed in 'Front Desk Holds' shelf. If you'd like locker storage, request code via People Ops.
Sasha (People Ops): @Maya R. please add full names + company to the visitor form: https://intranet.company/visitor-form -> we'll pre-print badges and flag security. Day passes OK if IDs presented but pre-prints are faster for groups.
Kevin L.: I've added the list. Also can we clear a couple hot-desks near main area for visitors? They might need table space between demos.
Facilities - Raj: We can reserve desks 12-15 and open Meeting Rm C as overflow seating. Note: Locker A is out for repair today, so no locker codes from there.
Maya R.: Thanks @Raj. Where should packages go in the meantime? Some are larger than the shelf.
Front-desk-bot: Suggestion: place oversize packages in Receiving Bay B (behind bike racks). I'll tag them with QR: `FD-1749-B`.
Oliver: If Receiving Bay B is used, can someone add it to the pickup map? New hires keep walking into the mail room.
Sasha (People Ops): Done — map updated and emailed to ops@redwood.com. Also: please remind visitors to check in 10 min early and bring a photo ID. :thumbsup:
Raj: I'll move the larger boxes to Bay B at 9:30am tomorrow and put temporary signage. :package:
Maya R.: Perfect — appreciate the quick turnaround. See you all tomorrow.
